name: Sharing your faith
description: Four weekly small-group lessons on how the first followers shared the good news — naturally, personally and with courage.

days.title: Starting where people are
days.note: Philip follows the Spirit's lead to a stranger on a desert road. He listens first, then starts from the very passage the man is reading.
questions: What did Philip do before he started explaining anything?
How can we start from where people already are?
Who might God be leading you towards this month?
days.prayer: Holy Spirit, open our eyes to the people You are already preparing, and give us courage to start a conversation.

days.title: A conversation at a well
days.note: Jesus crosses cultural and personal barriers to talk with a Samaritan woman. The conversation turns her into a messenger to her whole town.
questions: What barriers did Jesus cross in this conversation?
How did Jesus handle the woman's questions and side-steps?
What simple story could you tell, like she did in verse 29?
days.prayer: Jesus, help us see people the way You see them, and to cross the barriers that keep us apart.

days.title: Speaking into a culture
days.note: In Athens, Paul is troubled by what he sees but speaks with respect, starting from what his listeners already know.
questions: How did Paul connect with people who knew nothing of the Scriptures?
What 'altars to an unknown god' do you notice in our culture?
How did people respond, and what does that teach us?
days.prayer: Lord, give us wisdom to speak about You with both truth and respect.

days.title: Ready with a reason
days.note: Peter encourages believers facing hostility to be ready to explain their hope — gently and respectfully.
questions: What is the hope that is in you? Try putting it in two or three sentences.
Why do gentleness and respect matter as much as the words?
Looking back over four weeks, what will you do differently?
days.prayer: Lord, help us honour Christ as Lord in our hearts, and make us ready to share the hope we have with gentleness.
